news.title: Treasury cancels Booz Allen contracts after employee leaked Trump tax records; stock falls
news.description: Booz Allen employee Charles Edward Littlejohn also had leaked tax records of Amazon's Jeff Bezos and Tesla chief Elon Musk to a news outlet.

news.title: AI spending wasn't the biggest engine of U.S. economic growth in 2025, despite popular assumptions
news.description: The GDP value of AI is smaller than it might appear given that a lot of high-tech equipment is imported, according to a recent MRB Partners report.

news.title: GameStop shares move higher after Michael Burry says he's been buying the stock
news.description: Burry said his investment is a long-term value play rather than a wager on renewed meme stock speculation.
